name: Extract transcripts from entire YouTube channels to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## 🎬 Turn a whole YouTube channel into a transcript knowledge base

### Who's it for
Researchers, content teams and AI builders who need the text of a channel's back catalog — for RAG corpora, competitor research, newsletter mining or SEO briefs — without clicking through videos one by one.

### How it works
Paste a channel URL, handle or playlist into the Config node and run. A hosted Apify actor (called over plain HTTP, no API key juggling beyond one token) finds the channel's videos, downloads each transcript, and returns clean text per video. A Code node flattens the results to one row per video — URL, title, channel, language, word count and the full transcript — and appends them to your Google Sheet.

### Requirements
- An [Apify](https://apify.com) account + API token
- A Google account for Sheets

Cost is [$0.002 per delivered transcript](https://apify.com/beacondata/youtube-channel-transcript-scraper) — a 25-video channel costs about **$0.05**. Videos without captions, deleted or restricted videos are never charged, and the call carries a hard $1 cost cap.

### How to customize
Raise `maxVideos`, change the transcript `language`, schedule it weekly to catch new uploads, or point the output at Notion or a vector store instead of Sheets.

## 🛠 How to set up

1. **Create an Apify account** at [apify.com](https://apify.com) (takes a minute, card not required) and copy your API token from **Console → Settings → API & Integrations**.
2. **Create the credential:** in n8n choose **Create credential → Header Auth** and set
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (paste the token you copied in place of YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN)
   then select it on **Fetch Channel Transcripts**.
3. **Open **Config**** and set your own values.
4. Pick your **Google Sheets** credential on the last node and choose the spreadsheet + sheet to append to.
5. Run it once with the test button, check the output, then activate.
